texts.li: {A_nameDef} looked up from {A_possessive} work and found {X_indefinite} sitting on a rock a little way off, watching with great interest. When {A_nameDef} waved, it tilted its head.
All afternoon {A_nameDef} had the feeling of being watched, and at last caught {X_definite} peering from the long grass. It ducked out of sight, then peered out again.
While {A_nameDef} worked, {X_indefinite} crept closer and closer, until it was near enough to sniff {A_possessive} boot. Then it bolted, very pleased with itself.
{A_nameDef} saw it first: {X_indefinite}, but the wrong colour, its coat catching the light like a coin. {A_nameDef} stood very still and didn't breathe until it moved on.
There was a sparkle in the grass beyond the fields, and when {A_nameDef} went to look, there was {X_indefinite} unlike any {A_pronoun} had seen, shining strangely, as if somebody had painted it.
At the far edge of the land, {A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} crossing the ridge, unhurried, the kind trainers talk about for years. {A_nameDef} watched until it was out of sight.
{A_nameDef} came back from the fields breathless: {X_indefinite}, a rare one, drinking at the water as calmly as a goat. By the time anyone else looked, it was gone into the trees.
{A_nameDef} sat very still at the edge of the field holding out a berry, and after a long while {X_indefinite} came and took it from {A_possessive} hand. {A_nameDef} hasn't stopped talking about it.
{A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} played chase along the fence for most of the afternoon. It wasn't clear who was chasing whom.
{A_nameDef} was working alone when {A_possessive} Pokémon, {X_nameDef}, came and settled beside {A_objective}, just to be near. They stayed like that until the light went.
{X_nameDef} has learned the sound of {A_nameDef}'s footsteps, and comes running every time, whatever it was doing.
{A_nameDef} sat down after a long day and {X_nameDef} climbed into {A_possessive} lap, which it has been too big to do for some time. {A_nameDef} didn't have the heart to say so.
